title: Pandas Docks
summary: Import the Crew Log with pandas: read_csv, shape, columns, head(), nunique() and value_counts().
hints: `log.shape` is (rows, columns): `n_rows = log.shape[0]`, `n_columns = log.shape[1]`. `len(log)` also counts rows.
`log["number"].nunique()` counts different IDs; `log["number"].value_counts().max()` is the most missions anyone flew.
